invariants.rationale: The context should never be null when passed into this table method, as it is required for execution.
instantTime is expected to be a required parameter (typically uniquely identifying an operation instant), so should not be null.
Option parameters are typically non-null, even if they are Option.empty().
instantTime is usually expected to be a non-empty string representing a time or operation identifier.
If Option is present, get() should not be null; otherwise get() should not be called.
